titre: Projets de réseau de transport retenus en 2025
sous_titre: Montant des projets par gestionnaire de réseau américain, en Mds $, année 2025

Midwest.texte: MISO approved 432 projects totaling $12.3 billion in its 2025 Transmission Expansion Plan

PJM.texte: PJM is evaluating 134 transmission proposals ($11.6 billion) driven by regional load growth

Grandes Plaines.texte: SPP approved 50 projects ($8.6 billion) to address peak load that is projected to nearly double

Californie.texte: CAISO identified 31 projects ($4.8 billion) to accommodate 76 GW of generation capacity additions by 2039
